rationale: The agent appears to have canceled the entire order and issued a refund without authenticating the user, without confirming the order-changing action, and without attempting the user’s preferred sequence (split payment; if not, identify/cancel most expensive item; if not, switch to cheapest options; if not, cancel order). There are no tool call logs supporting the cancellation or refund details, so the stated refund amount and card digits are unsupported. These actions violate the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, act only on the user’s orders, and avoid unsupported claims.
